title: Technical legal terms and ordinary meanings
shortTitle: Technical legal terms and ordinary meanings
summary: A term of art carries a specialized meaning in a legal or professional setting that may differ from everyday usage.
notes:
Identify whether the statutory setting supplies a recognized technical sense before relying on an everyday dictionary. In the Murphy litigation, costs and attorneys’ fees had established legal meanings that did not automatically include expert fees. The dispute concerned whether statutory context and legislative materials established a deliberate departure from that baseline.

Katzmann accepts dictionaries as potentially useful for technical or historical usage but questions treating an isolated definition as sufficient when a phrase’s placement creates the ambiguity. A term’s legal meaning, the particular statutory definition, and evidence of intentional variation must be assessed separately.
